task_name: Collect Metal, Fulfill Advisor Offer, Pop Opinion Bubbles, and Queue Factories

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When factories have finished Metal, a Simoleon offer bubble appears on Town Hall, and blue opinion bubbles appear on homes.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Selling excess Metal (24 in storage) earns Simoleons while popping blue opinion bubbles maintains 99% happiness and provides chances for more free special items.
preconditions: Active advisor offer on Town Hall
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Collect Metal, accept the Town Hall trade offer, and refill empty factory slots with Wood and Metal.

steps.who: floating Metal on the northern Small Factories
Simoleon offer bubble on Town Hall
blue opinion bubbles on residential buildings
steps.briefing: pop the thought bubbles to keep Sims happy.
drag Wood and Metal into the empty production slots.
